findings: Legacy client uses ordinary Session defaults and Session.request. Its guarded Session.send receives the already merged proxy/CA settings and does not replace them.
Frozen modern trial dc351b0 explicitly disables trust_env before Session.request; future diagnostics a43f4a1 also supplies proxies={} directly to Session.send.
The first reconciliation dispatch document required trust_env=False/no proxy. Its actual executable transport/configuration was not inspected.

In dummy fixtures an ordinary Session.request uses environment proxy and CA settings; trust_env=False suppresses both. This is a plausible route conflict if such settings supply the supported executor route.
proxies={} passed to Session.request does not suppress environment proxies when trust_env=True; proxies={} passed directly to Session.send does.

Only changing trust_env=True while retaining direct Session.send(proxies={}) will still suppress proxies and omit environment CA merging. Direct send without proxies resolves a proxy but still does not perform the CA merge.

Connection failure without HTTP evidence establishes neither the actual environment configuration nor the local/network/provider cause. No claim of successful transmission or review denial is justified.
